name: CSC Clinical Companion
banner: Reference tool only. Do not enter any patient information.
bannerDetail: Not a medical record and not a referral submission. Nothing you select is saved or sent. Refreshing the page clears the screener and the intake checklist.
footer: Draft clinical content, pending medical team review. For Master's-level therapists and interns in Children's Specialty Care.
reviewerNote: This preview is for clinical review. Send comments to Mark.

modules.title: Eligibility and referral
modules.text: Walk the scope of service and leave with likely eligible, not eligible, or needs a consult — plus the BH23 box that matches who is referring.

modules.title: Intake guide
modules.text: Choose the referral source, the condition, and the developmental level. Get a printable list of questions, differentials, and how to adapt the work.

modules.title: Developmental lens
modules.text: Read cognition, language, perspective taking, and social-emotional development by stage, then switch Ahead, Typical, or Behind.

modules.title: Condition cards
modules.text: Therapy considerations for the illnesses CSC sits beside. Diabetes, cystic fibrosis, and pediatric cancer are fully drafted. The rest are stubs.

modules.title: Training map
modules.text: Find the recorded training that already covers a topic. Hours are filled in. Recording links are waiting to be added.

modules.title: Practice cases
modules.text: Three fictional vignettes for interns. Pick a response, read the feedback, and take it to supervision. Nothing is scored or stored.
